display_name.description: A human-friendly name for the uptime check configuration.
display_name.rationale: Display metadata with no security impact.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for the request to complete.
timeout.rationale: Operational setting with no direct security impact.

period.description: How often, in seconds, the uptime check is performed.
period.rationale: Frequency setting with no direct security impact.

content_matchers.description: The expected content on the page the check is run against.
content_matchers.rationale: Functional matching with no direct security impact.

selected_regions.description: The list of regions from which the check will be run.
selected_regions.rationale: Geographic setting with no direct security impact.

log_check_failures.description: Specifies whether to log the results of failed probes to Cloud Logging.
log_check_failures.rationale: Logging failures is good practice but not enforced as a security policy since it is not directly exploitable.

checker_type.description: The checker type to use for the check.
checker_type.rationale: Infrastructure routing choice with no direct security impact.

user_labels.description: User-supplied key/value data for organizing and identifying the UptimeCheckConfig objects.
user_labels.rationale: Organisational metadata with no security impact.

http_check.description: Contains information needed to make an HTTP or HTTPS check.
http_check.rationale: Parent block - security impact assessed at attribute level.

request_method.description: The HTTP request method to use for the check.
request_method.rationale: Request method choice with no direct security impact.

headers.description: The list of headers to send as part of the uptime check request.
headers.rationale: Functional setting; security is addressed via mask_headers policy.

use_ssl.description: If true, use HTTPS instead of HTTP to run the check.
use_ssl.rationale: SSL usage is enforced indirectly via validate_ssl_required policy.

validate_ssl.description: Boolean specifying whether to include SSL certificate validation as a part of the Uptime check.
validate_ssl.rationale: Disabling SSL validation on HTTPS uptime checks allows the check to pass even when the certificate is invalid, expired, or issued by an untrusted authority, undermining transport security assurances.

mask_headers.description: Boolean specifying whether to encrypt the header information.
mask_headers.rationale: When Authorization or other authentication headers are present, leaving mask_headers false exposes those credentials in plain text via the GCP API on Get/List calls.
mask_headers.non-compliant: mask_headers = false with Authorization header present

port.description: The port to the page to run the check against.
port.rationale: Operational setting with no direct security impact.

path.description: The path to the page to run the check against.
path.rationale: Functional setting with no security impact.

auth_info.description: The authentication information using username and password.
auth_info.rationale: Authentication is handled at the application level; no policy enforced here.

monitored_resource.description: The monitored resource associated with the configuration.
monitored_resource.rationale: Resource identifier with no direct security impact.

type.rationale: Resource type selector with no direct security impact.

labels.description: Values for all of the labels listed in the associated monitored resource descriptor.
labels.rationale: Functional identifiers with no security impact.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Organisational field, not a security control.
